claim-assertion-kind.definition: classification slot for a claim's asserted mode (for example source statement, definition or inference), not a closed vocabulary; requiredness is unresolved.
claim-assertion-kind.disposition: Retain separately from statement so a reader can distinguish assertion mode without asserting a populated corpus vocabulary.

claim-card-ref.definition: containing-card reference slot for a standalone claim, distinct from the claim's own id/revision and the card's outward claim list; requiredness is unresolved.
claim-card-ref.disposition: Retain an explicit containing-card tuple when supplied; do not infer it from heading placement or require reciprocal claim_refs.

claim-source-refs.definition: claim-scoped collection of source identity references.
claim-source-refs.disposition: Keep claim source references distinct from card citations and support attachments; the template's empty collection is not populated use.

claim-support-refs.definition: claim-scoped collection of source-support relation references.
claim-support-refs.disposition: Preserve assertion-specific support references; a card-level list or source citation cannot substitute.

claim-statement.definition: the exact assertion text, with qualifications and exceptions, rather than duplicated or broadened body prose.
claim-statement.disposition: Retain separately so a paraphrase, definition or inference can be checked at claim scope; only null template evidence was parsed.

card-claim-refs.definition: collection of claims a card makes discoverable; it does not prove every body assertion is structured or supported.
card-claim-refs.disposition: Keep collection, item and components distinct; retain empty, absent and populated contexts without manufacturing reciprocal claim records.

card-source-refs.definition: collection of source identity references at card scope, not selected assertion warrant.
card-source-refs.disposition: Preserve component tuples and their limits; a source citation locates a source but does not establish a claim-support relation.

card-source-snapshot.definition: legacy scalar snapshot token used by expanded candidates, distinct from the structured source reference tuple.
card-source-snapshot.disposition: Retain scalar form and do not silently coerce it to a source id/path/revision mapping or claim support.

card-support-refs.definition: card-level collection of support-record references, whose members retain their own assertion subjects and spans.
card-support-refs.disposition: Preserve collection and tuple components but do not promote a card list to blanket support for all claims or body prose.

memberships.effective_meaning: claim assertion-mode slot: it labels whether the statement is a source report, definition, hypothesis, or inference when populated; its template null does not establish requiredness or vocabulary.
memberships.disposition: Template-null only; retain claim mode separately and leave vocabulary/use unresolved.

memberships.effective_meaning: claim-to-containing-card reference tuple; it is neither the claim identity nor evidence that a card's claim_refs reciprocates it, and template null leaves requiredness unresolved.
memberships.disposition: Template-null only; preserve an explicit containing-card tuple when supplied, not inferred containment.

memberships.effective_meaning: collection of source identity tuples scoped to one claim, distinct from card-level citations and source-support relations.
memberships.disposition: Keep the empty template collection distinct from absent or populated card collections.

memberships.effective_meaning: collection of support-relation tuples attached to one claim; each relation must still name its subject/span and cannot be supplied by card membership.
memberships.disposition: Keep the empty template collection claim-scoped; no populated standalone claim is evidenced.

memberships.effective_meaning: exact claim wording, including attribution, modality, qualifications and exceptions; it is not a mechanically inferred duplicate of readable card prose.
memberships.disposition: Template-null only; preserve exact assertion scope separately from body duplication.

memberships.effective_meaning: card-level collection that exposes claim lookup tuples; absent, empty, and populated are different observed states and do not enumerate every body assertion.
memberships.disposition: Retain collection state (absent, empty or populated) without reading body headings as generated standalone claims.

memberships.effective_meaning: one claim-reference tuple within the card collection; it is a request to locate one claim, not a support assertion or target declaration.
memberships.disposition: Each item is one lookup request, not proof of target declaration or support.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested claim identifier inside one tuple; matching heading text is a bounded lookup observation, not a declared embedded claim-record identity.
memberships.disposition: Preserve requested claim id for identity lookup; observed headings are bounded lookup evidence, not a declared embedded record id.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested location for a claim tuple; `#...` is observed as heading-text lookup here, while literal fragment-anchor resolution remains unresolved.
memberships.disposition: Preserve path/fragment convention and distinguish literal fragment from heading-text lookup.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested revision for the referenced claim, separate from the containing card revision; no embedded-claim revision declaration or inheritance is established.
memberships.disposition: Preserve requested revision; no embedded claim revision inheritance is established.

memberships.effective_meaning: card-scoped collection of source-reference tuples; it identifies cited source context, distinct from scalar snapshot and assertion-specific support.
memberships.disposition: Keep source citation at card scope, distinct from scalar snapshot and assertion support.

memberships.effective_meaning: one source-reference tuple, combining requested id/path/revision components; its presence does not make it claim warrant or complete target agreement.
memberships.disposition: Each member is a source tuple request, not a support verdict.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested source-record identifier; `ccn-book` is requested in pilot/reruns, but the inspected acquisition/chapter targets do not declare that source-record id.
memberships.disposition: Retain requested source id; target declarations remain separately inspectable.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested source location: the pilot points to acquisition metadata, while reruns point to the absolute Chapter 1 Markdown target; a path locates but does not declare source identity.
memberships.disposition: Retain locator path but do not equate it with source-record identity.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested source revision: the pilot prefix and rerun full commit match the acquisition checkout commit, but neither target declares it as a source-record revision field.
memberships.disposition: Retain requested source revision; a commit token is not a complete declared source record.

memberships.effective_meaning: legacy scalar commit token at card root, observed in expanded candidates; it is not a structured id/path/revision tuple and cannot itself identify selected assertion support.
memberships.disposition: Keep legacy scalar snapshot as observed; do not reverse-engineer a structured source reference.

memberships.effective_meaning: card-level collection of support-reference tuples; it provides support navigation but does not warrant every card claim or sentence.
memberships.disposition: Keep support collection separate from citations and claim warrants.

memberships.effective_meaning: one support-reference tuple; it must be followed to its distinct assertion subject and selected source span before any warrant conclusion.
memberships.disposition: Each support entry needs its own subject/span inspection.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested support-record identifier; the pilot's separate support frontmatter declares it, while rerun heading text alone is not equivalent declaration.
memberships.disposition: Retain support identity request, but a matching heading alone is not full record identity.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested support location: pilot body links a separate file, while reruns use `#...` heading-style paths whose literal-anchor resolution is unresolved.
memberships.disposition: Retain locator/fragment convention and record unresolved literal-anchor behavior.

memberships.effective_meaning: requested revision of a support record; pilot support frontmatter declares revision 1, but rerun embedded headings do not declare a target revision and do not inherit the card revision.
memberships.disposition: Retain requested support revision; no target revision declaration is inferred from containment.
